::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [25 February 1881]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mary Yonge Society/4
:::

My dear [Mrs Elgie](people/person_475.qmd)

This is only to tell you that I am thinking about you and [Blanche](people/person_1480.qmd) and all.[^1]  I would come to see you, but I think you had better not see a fresh person, and besides [Annie Moberly](people/person_1024.qmd)comes to me tomorrow  May God bear you all through it

Ever yours affectionately
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Blanche Webber (b. 1859/60) a child of Mrs Elgie’s first marriage to Captain Webber.
